label: Telemetry ETL
info: Subscribes to +/+/+/telemetry, validates each payload, checks the asset against the registry, and inserts the reading into sensor_readings. Plant and area still come from the topic; they must match the assets row. A refused message is published to the topic rejected and inserted into rejected_messages.

name: Validate and enrich
Look up asset
query: SELECT plant, area FROM assets WHERE asset_id = $1

name: Match registry

Insert rejection
query:

VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)
